resources.string: The motor could not turn. Make sure nothing blocks the wheels, then switch the bike off and on.
Battery voltage too high. Unplug the charger and restart the bike.
Battery voltage too low. Charge the battery.
The sources disagree on this code; one reads it as motor too fast. Note when it appears.
The motor turned faster than allowed, for example downhill. Usually clears on its own.
The motor drew too much current. Restart the bike; if it comes back, have the motor checked.
The pedal sensor reports implausible values. Restart the bike with no weight on the pedals.
The pedal sensor gave odd values when the bike switched on. Restart it with no weight on the pedals.
The motor’s position sensors do not agree. Check the motor/sensor cable at the head tube.
Internal communication fault in the module. Restart the bike.
The mobile modem does not answer, so tracking may not work. Restart the bike.
The motor controller does not answer. Restart the bike; if it stays, check the controller cable.
The modem could not log on to the mobile network, so tracking may not work.
The battery delivers no power. Charge it and check the battery connector.
This bike model does not support that.
No S2 status service found. This is not an S2 or X2, or the Bluetooth cache is corrupted.
An older VanMoof answered (S/X 1, S/X 2 or SmartBike). If it is an S2 or X2, set that model for this bike in the garage.
YABA does not support this VanMoof model (SmartBike or Electrified S/X 1).
Only in S2 test mode: not yet confirmed on a real S2.
The bike sent no valid status block.
The assist level is not known yet, and the S2 sets region and level together. Try again in a moment.
The region is not known yet, and the S2 sets region and level together. Try again in a moment.
S2/X2 driver (experimental, not yet tested on a real S2)
The account says %1$s, but the bike has S3 services: using the S3 driver.
The bike reports the off-road region (37 km/h). The S2 sets region and level together, so changing the level here needs S2 test mode.
The S2 sets region and level together, and it now reports %3$s km/h at level %4$s instead of %1$d km/h at level %2$d. Check both settings.
S2 status block implausible (battery %1$d%%, module %2$d%%, speed %3$d): is the bike’s key right?
Changed bytes: %1$s. Implausible values: is the key right?
